scores.notes: Pseudo-text lines on the notice board by the station door (left); Holmes at the right window has a recognisable screen-actor likeness (gaunt slicked-hair face) with pipe and magnifier. White paper strip at the right edge and corners (accepted).
Villagers gather on the hillside facing the golden sky, one lifting a hand, with walled town, lit windows, shore and a mounted Roman soldier on the road at right; no lettering or defects seen.
Job with staff stands before the ash heap under a dust whirlwind and lightning-lit cloud; no figure in the storm, no lettering. Setting is a walled city rather than a village, minor.

Moses on the shore with staff, arm outstretched as the waves draw back from a wet seabed path, radiance through the clouds; no figure in the light. Small white paper bits in the bottom corners (accepted).
Disciples bail and row in a swamped boat on stormy water with a lamp at the mast and Jesus asleep on a cushion in the stern; hands and oars read plausibly, no lettering.

The picture is two stitched panels with a hard seam at the centre: a high view of the temple and city with a bronze sea on the left, and a separate eye-level view of Hezekiah at a golden door on the right, so the temple appears twice.
Alice sits thinking at a long tea-table under a big tree with the Hatter, March Hare and a sleeping Dormouse over a teacup; no lettering on the hat or cups, no film likeness seen.
Daniel lifts his hands toward flaming wheels in burning cloud above a plain and ziggurat city; no figure, face or body drawn within the fire.
A tired young man in a plain tunic looks up into light from the upper right before Jerusalem's walls and gate, with weary men against the wall and a dropped jar; no defects seen.
A painted signature sits in the bottom-right corner on the floor. Alice raises an unlabelled bottle in a long lamp-lit hall with a glass table, key and a curtained low door.

The bottle's tag carries the words 'DRINK ME' (centre). Otherwise Alice, the glass table with key and the tiny door to the garden match the scene; a little blank paper shows at the lower-left corner (accepted).
An old man lies on a woven mat with a woman kneeling beside him and family standing around near tents and mud-brick houses at dusk; white paper shows at the top corners and right edge (accepted).

Chariots and horsemen surge along a seabed between two towering water walls under dark cloud; they come toward the viewer rather than away, and Israelites are not clearly distinguished on the far shore, but the pursuit reads. No lettering or malformed horses.
The young man, dropped jar and weary men by the wall fit, but Jerusalem appears twice: a walled city with its own temple platform on the left hill and a second walled temple fortress on the right.

Disciples rouse Jesus asleep on a cushion in the stern, but the lower right shows a wooden deck or pier with coiled rope and net lying outside the hull while the boat is in open water, which places the boat in two settings.
David holds a staff and stone by the brook, but no sling is shown anywhere, and Goliath stands near and no taller than his shield bearer instead of towering on the far side. No lettering.
The card courtiers bear card indices and numerals ('A', '7', suit pips) at right. Alice, the floating Cheshire Cat head, the smiling Queen, flamingo and hedgehogs otherwise match.
Ezekiel stands with arm raised over a valley of scattered skulls and bones beneath bare hills; the tablet in his hand is blank. White vignette at the top corners (accepted).

Samuel pours oil from a horn on the kneeling David with Jesse and brothers at left, but a large group of white-bearded elders and others sits along the right, prominent and not part of the selected family.

Peter and disciples step off the boat toward the fire of fish and bread, but four more men already wait on the shore at right, one a long-haired Jesus-like figure, though Jesus is not selected. White paper sky at the top corners (accepted).

Moses strikes the cliff with his rod, water gushes out, Aaron in his breastplate stands beside him, and people and livestock drink, with tents beyond; the breastplate has no glyphs, and the crowded drinkers overlap but read plausibly.

Peter leaps from the boat with arms flung wide while a disciple points to Jesus standing by the coal fire on the shore; the boat holds fish and nets. Unpainted paper at the left top and corners (accepted).

The open papyrus sheet on the table at bottom right shows faint writing-like line marks, though the scrolls were asked to be unmarked. Paul holding the bronze mirror with believers under the colonnade otherwise matches.
Job with staff stands among ash heaps and broken pots under a dust whirlwind and lightning-lit cloud; no figure in the storm, no lettering. White paper shows at the corners (accepted).

The adder appears twice, at the ventilator and again on the floor. Watson's face (moustached, seated with pistol at right) closely resembles a screen actor's likeness. Pale paper at the bottom-left (accepted).
Golden radiance breaks through dark cloud over black rippling water with no figure or shape in the light; no lettering.
